title: Assistance
notConnectedYet: Assistance will be built in P08.

policy.pending: The values in use are provisional and await owner approval.
policy.advisory: Scoring is advisory only; the final decision belongs to a human reviewer.
policy.scoreHidden: The detailed score is not shown to the applicant in this version.

explain.needSeverity: Need severity: household size and dependents against income per person.
explain.incomeToNeeds: Income compared with essential monthly needs.
explain.availableAssets: Only assets actually available for disposal.
explain.seriousness: Seriousness of steps: engagement status and its proof document.
explain.jobStability: Job stability: continuity months with the income source.

engine.excluded: Relatives' wealth, unreceived inheritance and restricted assets are never counted.

realIncome.fail: A real income source is required to complete scoring.

notWealthy.pass: Available assets are below the rule threshold.
notWealthy.fail: Available assets reached or exceeded the rule threshold.

noPrior.fail: Prior assistance exists and no exception is approved.

recommendations.notEligible: Advisory: insufficient eligibility indicated; human review decides.
recommendations.additionalReview: Advisory: further verification is needed before any decision.
recommendations.partial: Advisory: partial assistance may fit after review.
recommendations.full: Advisory: full assistance may fit after review.
recommendations.humanReview: Advisory: routed to a human reviewer with no automated decision.

flags.identityDuplicate: Identity fingerprint used in another application
flags.phoneDuplicate: Phone fingerprint used in another application
flags.rapidResubmission: Repeated submissions in a short window
flags.incomeObligationMismatch: Declared income and obligations are inconsistent

errors.invalidTransition: This status cannot be reached from the current one.
errors.appealUsed: An appeal may be submitted only once.

why.identity: To verify the applicant and prevent duplicates, without publishing any data.
why.income_proof: To estimate actual income against needs.
why.engagement_proof: To prove seriousness without collecting the other party's details.

documents.limits: Maximum 5 MB for images and 10 MB for PDF files.
documents.pdfNote: PDF files are checked for type and size only; no image processing is applied.
documents.private: Documents are private to the applicant and never appear in search, notifications or public logs.

infoRequest.title: Information request
infoRequest.intro: We need a few clarifications to complete your review. This is not a rejection.

appeal.title: Submit an appeal
appeal.window: You may appeal once within {{days}} days of the decision.
appeal.pending: Your appeal is being reviewed by a different reviewer.

reference.label: Reference number
reference.demoNote: Demo number; the official one is minted server-side in P18.
